app.title: Time-lapse movie condenser
app.summary: A person loads a time-lapse fluorescence movie (or a synthetic demo), enters the frame interval and pixel size, and sets each method choice in a sidebar: photobleach correction, baseline percentile, how peak time is encoded, colormap, a coherence gate for reporting a wave, spatial denoising and brightness gamma. The tool condenses the movie into a temporal color code, estimates wave direction and speed from the activation-time map, and detects active regions. A verification panel draws the chosen wave axis and the region outlines over the std projection beside the recovered numbers, so the person can check them and, if needed, set the axis by hand and re-run. They download the one-image summary and a full multi-panel publication figure as 300 dpi PNGs.

task.text: Turn a time-lapse movie into one static, print-ready summary figure and a wave-speed estimate that only gets reported when it holds up.

data.text: A time-lapse fluorescence movie loaded as a stack of frames, from which per-pixel activation times, projections, a kymograph and per-region dF/F traces are derived.
data.item: one time-lapse movie, a stack of grayscale frames

stage.text: analyzing a recorded imaging movie and turning it into a figure for publication

mechanism.text: Sidebar controls each set one method parameter, and the whole pipeline re-runs on every change. Below it, the one-image summary, a verification overlay beside the recovered numbers, and the composite figure are redrawn, each with its own download button.

field.text: calcium imaging analysis of propagating waves in fluorescence microscopy

workflow.name: condense a time-lapse recording into one summary figure with a measured rate

steps.here: pick the synthetic demo or upload a TIFF stack or mp4/avi/mov video; the frame interval is read from ImageJ metadata if present

steps.step: set the units and method choices the computation depends on
steps.here: frame interval (s/frame) and pixel size (um/px); photobleach correction, F0 baseline percentile, peak or centre-of-mass time encoding, colormap, coherence gate, spatial denoise and brightness gamma

steps.step: compute a value from the data
steps.here: dF/F0 per pixel, a sub-frame activation-time map, a planar or local conduction-velocity speed estimate with a kymograph-ridge cross-check, and watershed-split active regions ordered by onset

steps.step: check the automatic choices against the data and override them
steps.here: the dashed wave axis and white ROI outlines are drawn over the std projection next to speed, planarity R2 and coherence; if wrong, switch off auto axis and type endpoints, or change the baseline percentile, then re-run

steps.step: look over every item at a glance
steps.here: a temporal color code (hue = time of peak, brightness = amplitude) and a composite with montage, kymograph, per-ROI dF/F heatmap and traces, std and max projections
download the one-image summary and the full figure as 300 dpi PNGs

distinctive: a coherence gate on the activation-time map means no speed is reported at all when the movie shows no oriented flow, rather than a guessed number
two speed estimators run (robust plane fit and local conduction-velocity field) and the plane fit's R2 picks which is reported, with an independent kymograph-ridge cross-check
photobleaching is fitted and divided out before any timing is measured, so peak times are not biased toward early frames
the whole movie collapses into one image where colour encodes when each pixel peaked and brightness how strongly, with colourblind-safe, print-safe colormaps
speed is converted to physical units only when both frame interval and pixel size are given

parts.title: Sidebar: data and methodological controls
parts.summary: Holds the numbered sections where the person picks the data and sets every method choice the pipeline uses.

parts.title: Data source and calibration
parts.summary: Chooses the synthetic demo or an uploaded TIFF/video and takes the frame interval and pixel size for physical units.

parts.title: Accuracy controls
parts.summary: Sets photobleach correction, baseline percentile, time encoding, colormap, coherence gate, spatial denoise and gamma, each with a help note on why it matters.

parts.title: Kymograph axis
parts.summary: Lets the person switch off the automatic PCA axis and type the kymograph line endpoints by hand.

parts.title: One-image summary (temporal color code)
parts.summary: Shows the movie collapsed to one image coloured by time of peak and brightened by amplitude, with a colorbar, and offers it as a 300 dpi download.

parts.title: Verification
parts.summary: Draws the wave axis and detected ROI outlines over the std projection beside the recovered speed, estimator, R2, coherence and ROI count, so the person can confirm the automatic choices before trusting the numbers.

parts.title: Full publication figure
parts.summary: Assembles a multi-panel figure (montage, temporal color code, kymograph with speed, per-ROI dF/F heatmap and traces, std and max projections) and offers it as a 300 dpi download.
